title: Count parked cells in status readers and carry the answer into the brief
action: Per contract decision 16031715 (D1 b7b5b3c7, D2 8ed6f4a2), using the park record and the `feature_parked_cells` / `park_answers` helpers cqp-1 added in verbs/cells/park.rs. Line numbers are hat-wave anchors; confirm each site with rg before editing. (1) Workflow run state (workflow_store/record.rs, around derive_run_state ~284-355): a lane whose cells are all capped except parked ones is not done; it reads as waiting on the human. (2) Merge-ready (workflow_store/merge_ready.rs ~149-155): a feature with a parked cell is never merge-ready. (3) Status counts (status_full/build.rs ~119-127, hooks/state_sync.rs ~896-901, orient.rs ~368-371): count parked cells as their own bucket; orient never calls a pipeline with a parked cell idle, and it names the parked cell count with the remedy `bee cells answer --id <cell> --answer "<text>"`. (4) state_group/policy.rs ~302-310: the start-feature unfinished check counts a parked cell as unfinished. (5) drivers/prepare.rs: the cell brief renders every answered park entry as `Answered question: <question> — <answer>` lines, so the answer reaches the next worker (D2). Do not trip contract_citation_refusal: an answer decision is not a contract decision and must not change that check. Tests red-first in each file's own test module: one per reader showing a parked cell changes the result, and a prepare test showing the answered question and answer text in the brief. REWORK after judge (NEEDS_REVISION): (a) the `bee status` text Cells line in status_full/render.rs shows no parked count and no answer remedy — print the parked count and the remedy `bee cells answer --id <cell> --answer "<text>"` when parked > 0; (b) policy.rs start_default prior-feature check filters open|claimed|blocked only — count a parked cell as unfinished there too, naming the answer remedy, the way start_lane already does; (c) prepare.rs renders the question and the answer raw into the brief — pass both through the same one-line collapse the file already uses for bundle titles, so a multi-line answer cannot inject brief lines. Tests red-first for each.
